agents.goal: Assess the candidate's legal knowledge and communication skills
agents.name: Interviewer

constraints: Answer questions without prior knowledge of the interviewer's questions
agents.goal: Demonstrate legal expertise and suitability for the role
agents.name: Candidate

agents.goal: Evaluate the candidate's cultural fit and overall impression
agents.name: Recruiter

causes.hypothesis: Higher legal knowledge leads to better performance in the interview
causes.name: Legal knowledge

causes.hypothesis: Clear communication improves the candidate's impression on the interviewer
causes.name: Communication clarity

causes.hypothesis: Candidates with better cultural fit are more likely to be hired
causes.name: Cultural fit

interaction.stopping_rule: The interaction stops after the recruiter provides the hiring decision

outcome.measurement_question: Was the candidate selected for the position?
outcome.name: Hiring decision
outcome.operationalization: Whether the candidate is offered the job or not

scenario: A person is interviewing for a job as a lawyer
